question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> be three vectors such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>·</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo></math> If the length of projection vector of the vector <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover accent="true"><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> on the vector <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>l</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>l</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> is equal to _____.

solution.text:
Given,

a→×b→=c→

⇒a→×b→·c→=c→2=12+122=2

Here, a→×c→=i^j^k^11101-1=-2i^+j^+k^

Projection of b→ on a→×c→=ℓ

⇒b→·a→×c→a→×c→=ℓ

⇒a→×b→·c→22+1+1=ℓ

∴ ℓ=26⇒ℓ2=46

So, 3ℓ2=2
